title: SEC2.1: watch.rs jmap_post opens new TLS connection per call
description:
fetch_and_notify calls jmap_post twice (Message/changes, Message/get) on lines 406, 440 of watch.rs. Each jmap_post opens a fresh TCP+TLS connection (lines 481, 484), causing unnecessary TLS handshakes. For a watch loop with one message per SSE event, this doubles the handshake cost.

Impact: High latency, excessive CPU/network for watch notifications.
Fix: Reuse connection across both JMAP calls or use HTTP/1.1 keep-alive.
Location: watch.rs lines 469-549 (jmap_post function), called from fetch_and_notify lines 406 and 440.
